select goods.id as goodsId, goods.name as goodsName, goods.introduce, goods.images, goods.price, goods.sort_introduce, goods.class_id as classId, class.name as className, IFNULL( avg( ev.score ), 0 ) AS score from goods as goods LEFT JOIN evaluation AS ev ON ev.goods_id = goods.id AND ev.type = 0 inner join class as class on class.id = goods.class_id
and class.id=#{goodsPageWxVto.categorySecond}
and goods.name like CONCAT('%',#{goodsPageWxVto.name},'%')
group by goods.id

select goods.id as goodsId, goods.name as goodsName, goods.introduce, goods.images, goods.price, goods.sort_introduce, goods.class_id as classId, class.name as className from goods as goods inner join class as class on class.id = goods.class_id where goods.id = #{goodsId} group by goods.id

SELECT goods.id AS goodsId, goods.NAME AS goodsName, goods.introduce, goods.images, goods.price, goods.sort_introduce, goods.class_id AS classId, class.NAME AS className, IFNULL(avg(ev.score), 0) AS score FROM goods AS goods LEFT JOIN evaluation AS ev ON ev.goods_id = goods.id AND ev.type = 0 INNER JOIN class AS class ON class.id = goods.class_id GROUP BY goods.id ORDER BY score DESC

SELECT t1.id, t1.goods_id, t1.orders, t1.honor_id, t1.reason, IFNULL(avg(t3.score), 0) AS score FROM honor_goods t1 LEFT JOIN honor t2 ON t1.honor_id = t2.id and t2.id = #{id} INNER JOIN evaluation t3 ON t3.goods_id = t1.goods_id GROUP BY t1.goods_id ORDER BY score DESC
